description: After fz-gee.1 both are Named { target, return_ty } / Closure { form, target, return_ty } related by a field-for-field conversion in jobs/artifact.rs / jobs/backend.rs. They name two products (materialized vs ABI-ready) that differ only in the target's representation. Fold: one generic over the target type, or one type with the ABI-ready stage carrying the resolved symbol in place; delete the conversion. Same shape as the BoundValue<W> fold in fz-gee.2.
title: MaterializedCallEdge and AbiReadyCallEdge are one two-variant enum spelled twice
